Datasheet rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001, pages [23, 94, 95, 93, 50, 27, 28, 61]:
**The rating is not one fixed value — it depends on which certification option (approval code) the transmitter was ordered with.** The datasheet lists many possible hazardous-area certifications, e.g.:

- Option code E5: USA Explosion-proof, Dust Ignition-proof [p. 23]
- Option code I5: USA Intrinsically Safe, Non-incendive (footnote: Non-incendive certification not provided with wireless, output code X) [p. 23]
- Option code E7: IECEx Flameproof; I7: IECEx Intrinsic Safety; N7: IECEx Type n [p. 23]
- Option code K8: ATEX Flameproof, Intrinsic Safety, Type n, Dust (combination of E8, I1, N1) [p. 23]
- Option code E4: Japan Flameproof — footnote: only available with 4-20 mA HART® (A), FOUNDATION Fieldbus (F), or PROFIBUS PA (W) output, and only with aluminum housing and 1/2 NPT conduit entry (housing code A) [p. 23]
- Option code C6: Canada Explosion-proof, Dust Ignition-proof, Intrinsically Safe, and Division 2 [p. 23]
- Option code KS: USA, Canada, IECEx, ATEX Explosion-proof, Intrinsically Safe, Dust, Non-incendive, Type N, Division 2 [p. 23]

(Similar codes exist for the other models, e.g. Rosemount 3051C on its ordering-information pages and 3051CFC/CFP/CFA on pages 40, 50 and 61. "Intrinsically Safe" means the electrical energy is limited so it cannot ignite an explosive atmosphere; "Flameproof/Explosion-proof" means the housing contains any internal ignition.)

**About opening the cover:** the datasheet does not give a rule saying the cover may or may not be opened with power on. It does say, as a feature, that you can "Configure in hazardous-area locations without removing the transmitter cover using external buttons" — i.e. the external buttons let you configure the device in a hazardous area without opening the cover (see "Quick service buttons", p. 3). I could not find in the datasheet an explicit statement about whether live working / opening the cover with power on is permitted or whether power must be isolated first. For detailed approval and certification information, the datasheet refers to the Rosemount 3051 Quick Start Guides [p. 95].
